Very Poor Quality food and very unclean
Feb 2017
of all the restaurants i reviewed in Vietnam Oya Gyros are the worst.. by american standards the Health dept would of shut this place down ten minutes after it opened.. Hair in my food, ants all over the tables and not quality food.. avoid this place like the plague
Written April 9, 2017
OYAGyros
Dear Mr. GARY C

Firstly, we thank you for your interests
Secondly, we appreciate every single review on our biz regardless it's a good one or a bad one because we respect every customer's own opinion.

However we're wondering if you did really visit our shop @ this address 80 Ton That Tung or eat our food here?
We did have 2 small tables outside when we first opened in Mar-2016 but after a few months the government didn't allow that anymore. Because you have a Viet wife so she may know about this high-light issue that the city officer is strictly cleaning the sidewalk especially in town and since the last Xmas 2016 we can't afford to put even a small plastic stool in front for the staff to sit.

We just found it a bit weird so we had a look at all the notification emails sent by tripadvisor and we found out that:
(1) 07-Feb-17 Review on OYA Gyros @69 Hoang Hoa Tham (1st & only time visit with ants/wrong order...) --> This is detected and deleted by Tripadvisor
(2) 21-Feb-17 Review on OYA Gyros @69 Hoang Hoa Tham again BUT in Q&A box
(3) 22-Feb-17 Review on OYA Gyros @69 Hoang Hoa Tham in Q&A box AGAIN with the same content with (2)
(4) 04-Mar-17 Review on OYA Gyros @80 Ton That Tung with the edited content but basically similar to (1) --> This is detected and deleted by Tripadvisor
(5) 05-Mar-17 Review on OYA Gyros @80 Ton That Tung again BUT in Q&A box
(6) 05-Mar-17 Review on OYA Gyros @80 Ton That Tung again in Q&A box with the edited content
(7) 11-Apr-17 Review on OYA Gyros @69 Hoang Hoa Tham again with add-on content (ants/hair...)
(8) 11-Apr-18 Review on OYA Gyros @80 Ton That Tung again with add-on content (ants/hair...)

We are trying to contact and ask Tripadvisor to restore your 2 first reviews on our 2 locations that they deleted after a short while (we never asked them to, they seemed to smell something too).
And we also hope that they won't delete your reviews this time so everybody can have a clear look at all the activity logs with details.
If they will, for sure we will have to suffer from the next reviews with extra add-on content... Regardless of being determined to be unusual and deleted later by Tripadvisor, our biz will be badly affected enough during the time they are on!

Since we have some locations and as the owner & the management, we can't be available 24/24 at all shops to take care of 100% of the customers. And for sure that we've never met you before face to face. So we're also trying to find out the real truth.
We're willing to publicly apologize if we or any staff did a seriously wrong thing to cause a grudge...

Thank you for spending your precious time on all these!!!

Sincerely yours,
Paul & Leslie

Perfect, amazing, delicious, and cheap
Mar 2017 • Couples
This place is good beyond belief. It was so good we came back again later the same day. We tried a bunch of different wraps, all great. Mushroom wrap looks enticing, but no chance to try it, so it will have to wait for next time.

Don't be put off by one guy behind the counter to prepare all the food. He's really nice and he knows what he's doing. Perfect blend of sauce, even the fries inside were perfect.

We're refugees from Zeus ever since it went way downhill, and this is our new favorite for gyros/wraps. Great place.

Note: only takeout, though they have a few plastic stools in front of the shop in case you really want to eat then and there.

Also note: there are a few businesses sharing the same address of 80 Ton That Tung. When we first went, we saw a computer shop at the address, and thought Oya must've gone out of business. Wrong. There's a computer shop at 80 Ton That Tung, some other shop, and also Oya, all with the same address. Just look around, including looking around the corner, and you'll find it.

SUPER
Jul 2016 • Family
You will be surprised with their kind of huge menu for a small but tidy and well organised open-kitchen.
We can see through the whole process when they cook the food, everything is clean.
My wraps were SUPER DELICIOUS, friendly staff and reasonable price in town.
I first ordered 2 wraps for me & my husband and a box of fries for my kids.
They refused to sell the fries though I saw them just finished boiling the potatoes.
They explained that they don't use the frozen potatoes but the fresh local potatoes everyday and the potatoes that rainy day would not be good enough for the chips.
We came back the next day for the chips again and it was really really tasty. You don't find that quality in many places.
We appreciate the way they respect their own business by respecting the benefits of the customers, not just one-time turnover...
